professionalSummary: Controls Engineer with experience writing structured‑text and ladder logic for ControlLogix controllers, redesigning HMI alarm pages, and managing version control of controller programs. Holds ISA/IEC 62443 Cybersecurity Fundamentals Specialist training and is preparing for certification. Demonstrated commissioning support and collaboration with IT security on plant network zoning.
experienceHighlights: Wrote PLC programs for case packers and labellers on ControlLogix controllers (src_b31df9191c08).
Redesigned HMI alarm pages for three lines (src_b31df9191c08).
Moved 140 controller programs into a version‑control tool with check‑in comments and named reviewers (src_15fce2f03485).
Ran I/O checks and authored operator handover sheets during line changes (src_435d2ecbc6c9).
Participated in IT security workshops to zone the plant network and document conduits (src_fcc51d8abeb7).
projectsAndWorkSamples: Change record for line 4 labeller program, including program diff, reviewer comments, I/O checklist, and supervisor acceptance (src_2b0b125f582c).
skills: PLC programming (IEC 61131‑3), HMI design, version control (Git), I/O commissioning, plant network zoning, ISA/IEC 62443 Cybersecurity Fundamentals Specialist training
